create.name: Dr. Jacob Israel Liberman
create.bio:
Dr. Jacob Israel Liberman trained as an optometrist and vision scientist and spent much of his career researching light and colour, leading two professional bodies in that field, among them the subtle-energy research society ISSSEEM. A personal turning point in 1976 led him from the clinic towards a wider question about how light, seeing and awareness are connected, and over the decades that inquiry became increasingly contemplative.

Today he teaches about presence: living from direct perception rather than from belief, and letting life itself guide decisions. He shares this through talks given to audiences around the world, short reflections on his YouTube channel, and a ten-week one-to-one mentorship on Zoom for people in positions of leadership, which includes his colour-based self-observation kit. His books include Luminous Life, written with Gina and Erik Liberman, which links the science of light to everyday living, and the short contemplative collection Wisdom From An Empty Mind. He has also taught an online course, The Light That Sees You, through The Shift Network.

books.title: Luminous Life: How the Science of Light Unlocks the Art of Living
books.author: Jacob Israel Liberman
books.description: Written with Gina and Erik Liberman, the book draws on his decades of work with light to argue that light links perception, awareness and the way we live. It moves from science towards a contemplative view of being guided by life.

courses.title: Life Mentorship Program
courses.description: Ten weekly one-hour sessions with him on Zoom, aimed at leaders who want personal guidance on how they live and work. First-time participants also receive his colour kit, and an initial consultation is required before joining.

courses.title: Consulting
courses.description: One-to-one consultations on Zoom for individuals, couples and organisations, combining his perception and guidance with his light and colour tools. Booking is through his website.

courses.title: The Light That Sees You
courses.description: His online course with The Shift Network, linked from the shop on his own site, on light, seeing and awareness. Details and dates are on the course page.

free_resources.title: Wisdom From An Empty Mind excerpt
free_resources.description: A free excerpt from his short book of contemplative sayings, sent as a welcome gift when you join his newsletter.
